answer: Audits voyage across the network each epoch, with odds rising by cluster: identities sharing funding, timing, or fingerprints form a cluster, so a lone agent faces a 1% chance while a 1.000-identity farm is audited surely. Each identity posts a 20.000 POA bond; one fingerprint echoes through the cluster, so one failed audit seizes every bond in it, half burned and half to the auditor, and freezes it 10 epochs. 1.000 fakes lock 20.000 x 1.000 = 20.000.000 POA with certain loss on the horizon; an honest agent risks 20.000 once. Limit: honest agents sharing one device can look like a cluster.
